intro: Lonebrow's Journal is a weathered diary found clutched in the skeletal remains of the dwarven explorer Henrig Lonebrow at the base of the Great Lift. Its pages detail the final grim journey of Lonebrow through Thousand Needles and point toward dangers lurking within Razorfen Kraul.

sections.t: A Dying Wish at the Great Lift
p: Henrig Lonebrow met an unfortunate end near the base of the Great Lift connecting the Barrens to Thousand Needles. Lying abandoned on a rocky ledge, his skeletal remains still grip this weathered journal. The diary serves as a testament to his final travels and directs whoever discovers it to bring word to the night elf druid Falfindel Waywarder at Thalanaar, the border outpost leading into Feralas. Lonebrow's notes shed critical light on the quillboar menace brewing in the southern barrens.
